observation.detail: No registered observation-digest-v1 capability existed, and no local or open-source reusable candidate was present in the mission directory or an available capability_library. One bounded acquisition authored a dependency-free Node procedure at procedures/observation-digest-v1.js (sha256 3b85b93000db6393956b9fa7e428dce431965d8d729432c478819c0f706455d5, unchanged across the probe). Qualification ran the candidate twice from scratch output directories probe/scratch-run-1 and probe/scratch-run-2 inside the mission dir, never from the final args output directory (the mission root still holds no digest.json/digest.md). It independently read input/pilot.observations.json (sha256 412c65c3e20f2154045686615f37a5f905a88598a3c2c08149db51fda8523766) and produced row_count 3, scheduled 30, completed 26, incidents 6, completion_percent 86.67, and a sites object {North: rows 2 / 22 / 18 / 5, South: rows 1 / 8 / 8 / 1}. Those totals were confirmed by a separate python3 recompute and exact-rational check (26/30 = 13/15, 18/22 = 9/11, 8/8 = 1), not by trusting the candidate's own output. A scratch-copy perturbation adding one East row moved totals to row_count 4, scheduled 34, completed 27, completion_percent 79.41 and created the new site key, proving arithmetic is derived from input bytes rather than embedded. Both runs were byte-identical (digest.json sha256 9cd7f88dc7782d713708a0fba8f76400753253e04aec3c333209dd496ae54382). Full evidence is in probe/qualification-receipt.json. The candidate installs nothing, opens no network, and is not trusted or installed by this plan: it becomes usable only when this Head replans against a verified qualified procedure. No packages, network, or host configuration were touched.
